recommendations: For managing Type 2 Diabetes, eat fiber-rich whole grains like Ragi, Bajra, Oats, and whole wheat. Include fresh green leafy vegetables, lean proteins, and healthy fats. Avoid refined sugar, white polished rice, white bread, sugary drinks, and high-glycemic fruits like mangoes or grapes.
source: ICMR Guidelines for Diabetes Management & WHO Healthy Diet Guidelines
